facts.fact: Levellers says Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection is in force, with enforceability after a grace period ending 23 June 2026.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Levellers says that per the AU status list Cameroon has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
Levellers says the Personal Data Protection Authority had not been created by presidential decree or made operational as of mid-2026.
